name: external_cheatengine_patch_tick_ac
description: Public Cheat Engine table, repeated health freeze. Paired with the single-write case using the same table and CE build. Operator-driven capture; no manipulation section.

extra.provenance: docs/external-cheats/README.md; fill actual tool/game hashes and runtime version before collection.
extra.operator_commands: Open the pinned CT file in Cheat Engine and attach to the printed AC PID. Verify HP Pointer (entry ID 18), set it to 777 and freeze ONLY that entry for 30 seconds. Record the CE freeze interval and verify health stays fixed under bot damage. Unfreeze, close CE without saving, then press Enter in the capture shell.
extra.success_criterion: Verify intended effect using game state, tool log, or payload marker independently of detector output. Record failed pilots separately.
extra.notes: Fresh AC and the same local bot match per replicate. See docs/external-cheats/evaluation-plan.md. Keep AC alive through cooldown; runner performs final cleanup.
extra.execution_mode: User-mode memory APIs only; CE kernel read/write, DBVM, debugger and speedhack features OFF.
